audit.why: The prose addresses the owner in second person, so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy. These templates were authored for a male enemy and only the champion name was substituted, leaving the pronouns wrong. champ-data/champ-gender.js is the authority.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mercs-Steelcaps by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Janna is the disengage answer to your hard engage, so the level 1-2 phase favors his — the instant you W-slam in, his Q knockup and Zephyr slow peel you right back off his ADC. Don't waste your engage into a full-health Janna with cooldowns up; poke and freeze instead. Ward for the jungler because a coordinated gank is how you actually get a kill through his peel.

edits.before: From 3-6 he keeps shielding and slowing every trade you try to force. Your dismount burst is real, but his shields and Zephyr blunt it and reposition you off target. Treat your W stun as a pick tool on an isolated target, and set up with your jungler rather than swinging lane trades he always wins on disengage.

edits.before: You get W (Ferromancy: Crash Down) at 2 and want to slam-engage, but Janna's Q (Howling Gale) and W (Zephyr) exist to punish exactly that — his monkey's-paw disengage means every all-in you start he can peel back. Only commit if his Q is on cooldown, and expect him to slow you with W the moment you dismount-stun his ADC.
